name: Dampened Greatclub of the Scrag
upgradeable: Altar of Vulkoor to Greatclub of the Scrag

effects.name: Dampened
effects.tooltip: Dampened : This item has been in a wet environment for too long and its original power has been weakened. Combine it with a Token of Vulkoor at the Altar of Vulkoor in the Red Fens to restore it back to its former glory.

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +2 Enhancement Bonus : +2 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls .

effects.name: True Chaos
effects.tooltip: True Chaos : This weapon is infused with the power of True Chaos. It does an additional 1 to 6 damage to non-chaotic targets and can only be wielded by Chaotic-aligned characters.

effects.name: Cold Touch
effects.tooltip: Cold Touch : The temperature around this weapon is colder than normal. A cold touch weapon deals an additional +1 cold damage on a successful hit.

effects.name: Regeneration
effects.tooltip: Regeneration : Causes the wearer to regenerate 1 hit point a minute using positive energy.

flavor_text: This particularly nasty weapon once belonged to one of the Scrag in High Priestess' Slikir's service. It seems that when the troll was killed, its blood seeped into this club, granting the weapon some of the creature's characteristics.
